locale.name: brick.settings.textColor.desc
locale.en: This setting is only necessary if a contrasting color to the background image or background color is needed to ensure the readability of the text.

locale.name: brick.settings.separatorTop.image.desc
locale.en: Select a suitable image that can serve as a separator between the current and the previous block. Example generators: www.shapedivider.app and getwaves.io

locale.name: brick.settings.separatorTop.width.desc

locale.name: brick.settings.separatorBottom.image.desc
locale.en: Select a suitable image that can be used as a separator between the current and the next brick. Example generators: www.shapedivider.app and getwaves.io

locale.name: brick.settings.separatorBottom.width.desc
locale.en: If no value is entered, the width of the image is used. Please enter a value with unit. Examples: 100%, 100vw, 500px, 40rem, etc.

locale.name: brick.settings.separatorBottom.height.desc
locale.en: If no value is entered, the height of the image is used. Please enter a value with unit. Examples: 100%, 100vw, 500px, 40rem, etc.

locale.en: This zone functions similarly to the header suffix zone. The only difference is that the menu floats above the module.

locale.name: area.topBanner.description
locale.en: Slim brick area above the menu for short sales, Black Friday or promotional messages.

locale.name: area.navAction.description
locale.en: Simple area in the navigation section to place e.g. a CTA button, a login link, or a dashboard link.

locale.en: Yes, use color set in template setting for header

locale.name: siteSettings.pageCustomClass.desc
locale.en: For developers: you can give a page a separate CSS class. This is set on the <body> tag. This way you can address the page not only by ID. It is helpful if e.g. Live and Dev environment exist (or local installation), which are not exactly the same.

locale.name: siteSettings.independentMenuId.desc
locale.en: The option allows to set separate and independent menu for single page.

locale.name: siteSettings.independentMenuIdLoggedIn.desc
locale.en: If a user is logged in, this menu is used for this page instead of the default menu.

locale.name: site.settings.nav.initialTransparent.desc
locale.en: If the navigation bar is fixed (always visible at the top) and the "Navigation bar is initially transparent" option is enabled in the project settings, the menu items may be difficult to read in some cases. With the options below, you can define the colors for each page individually to match the background image.

locale.name: site.settings.nav.scrollOffset.desc
locale.en: Overrides the template scroll offset for this page. Leave empty to use the template setting. Values starting at 0 are allowed.

locale.name: site.settings.nav.initialTransparent.logo.desc
locale.en: The project logo may be difficult to recognize when the navigation bar is transparent. With this setting, you can specify an alternative logo to be used specifically for the transparent navigation bar.

locale.name: site.settings.nav.initialTransparent.linkColorHover
locale.en: Link color on hover(navigation bar is transparent)

locale.name: site.settings.nav.initialTransparent.linkBgColorHover
locale.en: Link color on hover(navigation bar is transparent)

locale.name: admin.layout.fullWidth.desc
locale.en: Full width without container. Content controls its own width via the classes qui-content-grid, qui-content-wide and qui-content-full.

locale.name: admin.layout.leftSidebar.description
locale.en: Default layout with the sidebar on the left

locale.name: bricks.Startpage3Box.title
locale.en: Three-column block on the home page

locale.name: settings.includeDemoStyling.desc
locale.en: If the option is active, additional CSS rules and, if necessary, images are included. This setting is usually useful when the project has been created with demo data, for example, during the QUIQQER installation.

locale.name: settings.typography.heading.fontWeight.desc
locale.en: This setting allows you to define the font weight of headings (h1, h2, etc). Typical value is "700 - Bold". Please note that the selected font weight must be supported by the chosen font.

locale.name: settings.typography.text.fontWeight.desc
locale.en: This setting allows you to define the font weight. Typical value is "400 - Normal (Regular)". Please note that the selected font weight must be supported by the chosen font.

locale.name: settings.typography.text.fontSize.desc
locale.en: Base font size for flowing text. Typical value is "16px".

locale.name: settings.typography.contentTablesScrollable.desc
locale.en:
If this option is enabled, tables in editorial content are automatically wrapped in a horizontally scrollable container. This keeps wide tables usable on small viewports without affecting other tables in the template.

You can exclude individual tables from this behavior by adding either the CSS class no-table-scroll or the attribute data-qui-disable-table-scroll="1" to the table.

locale.name: settings.overline.style.desc
locale.en:
An overline is a small uppercase label displayed above a heading. This setting defines the default appearance for elements with the CSS class overline.

Individual overlines can deviate from the default by adding a variant class, e.g. overline overline--dot. The class overline-center centers the overline.

Numbered overlines count up automatically across the page. The class overline-reset (on a surrounding container or on the first overline of a group) restarts the counting at 01. When building multiple groups, give every group its own overline-reset.

The text color is defined by the "Overline text color" setting and can be overridden per overline with the classes overline-primary and overline-neutral. Icons (e.g. Font Awesome) inside the overline adapt automatically; decorative icons should get aria-hidden="true".

locale.name: settings.overline.textColor.desc
locale.en: Defines the default text color of overlines. "Neutral" inherits the text color from the surrounding context (recommended; the accent color stays reserved for the symbol). Can be overridden per overline with the classes overline-primary and overline-neutral.

locale.name: showHeader.desc
locale.en: On witch site layouts should be the header displayed?

locale.name: showBreadcrumb.text
locale.en: On which pages should breadcrumb navigation be displayed?

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.breadcrumb.showTitle.description
locale.en: Controls whether a heading is shown above the breadcrumb navigation. If no option is selected, the breadcrumb control default is used.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.breadcrumb.titleText.description
locale.en: Optional multilingual text for the breadcrumb navigation heading.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.breadcrumb.firstItemText.description
locale.en: Optional multilingual replacement text for the first visible breadcrumb entry. URL and target remain unchanged.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.breadcrumb.fontSize.description
locale.en: Selects the font size of the breadcrumb navigation.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.breadcrumb.separator.description
locale.en: Selects the separator between navigation items.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.breadcrumb.lastItemStyle.description
locale.en: Determines how the last breadcrumb item is highlighted.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.breadcrumb.spacing.description
locale.en: Controls the vertical padding of the breadcrumb navigation and passes the selected value directly to the breadcrumb control. Can be overridden in the theme via --theme--qui-tpl-breadcrumb-spacing.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.breadcrumb.appearance.description
locale.en: Defines how the breadcrumb navigation is visually styled in the template.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.headerHeightValueMobile.desc
locale.en: If no value is set, the desktop height will be used. Please note that the value is a minimum height that can also be influenced by several factors, e.g. padding-top and padding-bottom or the length of the text in the header (if the setting is enabled).

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.logoWidth.desc
locale.en: In most cases, you don't need to set the logo width. The template automatically calculates the width based on the specified height. In rare cases, QUIQQER may not be able to perform the calculation (e.g. if the logo is an .svg image). If the logo is a .svg image, the width must be entered.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.logoTitle.desc
locale.en: Optional text shown as a tooltip when hovering over the logo (HTML title attribute of the logo link).

locale.name: settings.bricks.bgColor.desc
locale.en: Default background color for bricks. If you activate a background color in the brick setting, you can either choose your own or use the color predefined with this setting.

locale.name: settings.bricks.textColor.desc
locale.en: Default text color for bricks. If you activate a text color in the brick setting, you can either choose your own or use the color predefined with this setting.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.nav.maxWidth.desc
locale.en: Any valid CSS value is allowed, e.g. 100%, 100vw, 500px, 40rem, etc. Default value: 1200px.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.navPos.description
locale.en: Defines how the navigation behaves while scrolling. With "Fixed - hides while scrolling" the menu is hidden when scrolling down and shown again when scrolling up; at the top of the page it is always visible.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.navPos.fix
locale.en: Fixed - page menu is always visible at the top, even when the page is scrolled down.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.navPos.scroll
locale.en: Scroll - page menu is no longer visible when the page is scrolled down.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.navStyle.description
locale.en: This option allows you to customize the menu design. Selecting “No Design” means that no template-specific adjustments will be applied to the menu. Only the default design of the menu module will be used. This option is useful when using a child template and you want to style the menu individually with your own CSS.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.navStyle.defaultWithBigButtons
locale.en: Template default design with big buttons

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.navAlignment.description
locale.en: Defined the vertical alignment of navigation entries.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.navBarInitialTransparent.desc
locale.en: When the navigation bar is fixed (always visible at the top), it has the configured background color by default. If you activate this option, the navigation bar will initially be transparent when a header image is enabled or a widget is placed in the "Header – Additional Widget Area". As soon as the page is scrolled, it will use the previously configured colors.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.navBarScrollOffset.desc
locale.en: Defines the scroll position at which the fixed navigation bar switches to its scrolled state. This is especially relevant when the "Navigation bar is initially transparent" option is enabled. Default: 50 pixels.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.navBarInitialTransparentLogo.desc
locale.en: The project logo may be difficult to recognize when the navigation bar is transparent. With this setting, you can specify an alternative logo to be used specifically for the transparent navigation bar.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.navBarInitialTransparentLinkColorHover.text
locale.en: Link color on hover(navigation bar is transparent)

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.navBarInitialTransparentLinkBgColorHover.text
locale.en: Link background color on hover(navigation bar is transparent)

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.searchShow.text
locale.en: Show search button in nav bar

locale.name: template.settings.independentMenu.menuId.desc
locale.en: If a custom (independent) menu is selected, this will be displayed as navigation. The menu can be set per language; languages without their own selection use the menu of the default language.

locale.name: template.settings.independentMenu.menuIdLoggedIn.desc
locale.en: If a user is logged in, this menu is displayed instead of the default independent menu. The menu can be set per language; languages without their own selection use the menu of the default language.

locale.name: template.settings.independentMenu.showFirstLevelIcons
locale.en: Show icons in the first level

locale.name: template.settings.mobileMenuBackground.desc
locale.en: This setting works only for mobile.

locale.name: template.settings.colorFooterLinkHover.desc
locale.en: Link color when mouse hovers over it

locale.name: template.settings.colorMainContrast.description
locale.en: Font color for elements that use the main color as background (e.g. chips, FAQ headers, badges).

locale.name: template.settings.buttonFontColor.description
locale.en: Overrides the contrast color for buttons only. Leave empty to use the contrast color of the main color.

locale.name: template.settings.colorMain.description
locale.en: Set the color of links, buttons, etc.

locale.name: template.settings.colorMainContentBackground.text
locale.en: Background color of the page content

locale.name: social.linksNote
locale.en: Please enter links including the protocol (https://). Only social media profiles with a saved link will be displayed.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.search.desc
locale.en: Note: The search will only be displayed in the navigation if there is a page with the page type "Standard search" or "Advanced search".

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.footer.showToTop.description
locale.en: Shows or hides the "back to top" bar at the end of the footer.

locale.name: templatePresentation.settings.footer.toTopStyle.description
locale.en: Defines how the "back to top" bar below the footer is styled. The whole area stays clickable.
